_doc: Platform-FREE profile for any short ad video (LinkedIn, Meta, YouTube, anywhere). Machine curves are HYPOTHESES tuned for scroll-stopping (evidence grade O, see ad-creative/references/rules.md), stricter than launch films. Platform limits (length, aspect, fps, file size) are checked separately by ad-creative/scripts/check_export.py against a platform adapter.

hook_relevance.title: Hook relevance
hook_relevance.question: Does the first 2 s speak to a SPECIFIC person and pain (a role, a problem, a number) rather than showing a generic product shot or logo? Look at hook.png.

anchors.8: names the persona or pain in the first frames
anchors.10: the target buyer would feel called out

proof.title: Proof
proof.question: Is there concrete proof (a real UI moment, a number, a named customer, a demo of the result) rather than an unsupported claim? Numbers must be the brand's own or clearly labelled illustrative.

anchors.10: proof the buyer can verify or cannot argue with

cta_clear.title: Clear ask
cta_clear.question: Is the next step explicit, singular, and matched to the offer (demo, guide, webinar)? Is it visible long enough to read?

anchors.5: ask exists but vague or brief
anchors.8: one clear ask, readable, matches the offer
anchors.10: the ask feels like the natural end of the story

sound_off.title: Works with sound off
sound_off.question: Watch with the audio ignored: is the whole message carried by on-screen text/captions/visuals, are captions legible at phone size and clear of platform UI areas?

anchors.10: designed silent-first, audio only adds polish

single_message.title: One message
single_message.question: Does the ad carry exactly one idea for one persona?

anchors.10: one idea, memorable in a sentence
